Summary: Checks whether AI delegation boundaries, refusal logic, and human-oversight assumptions are explicit before AI-assisted execution proceeds.
EntryCriteria: An AI-assisted step or AI-generated output path is proposed for real process use.
ExitCriteria: Delegation boundary, review obligations, and stop conditions are explicit and staffed.
Checks: Allowed and forbidden task types are documented.
Required human review points are explicit.
Prompt package and model identity are versioned.
Refusal and escalation behavior are defined.
Evaluation evidence exists for the intended use boundary.
